messages:
Avery: Quick sync — SOC2 fieldwork is scheduled Apr 7-9. We need a final KMS/HSM evidence handoff plan and confirmation of owners for each artifact. Who can take what?

Devon: I can own the keystore cutover checklist and the staging HSM access matrix. Can someone confirm the cutover window (we prefer Apr 6 maintenance window) and whether staging HSM creds are ready?

Priya: I’ll own the staging cutover smoke tests and the runbook snippets. Artifacts I expect to collect:
```
- auditlog export (signed)
- key rotation timestamps + rotation proof
- access entitlement matrix (who/when)
- keystore configuration snapshot
- HSM attestation blob
```

Marcus: Oncall is available Apr 6-10. Post the runbook snippet here and I’ll add escalation contacts. Also please flag any high-risk steps for rollback.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4821 "KMS fieldwork evidence handoff" — assignees: Devon, Priya — due: 2026-04-05. https://redwood.internal/SEC-4821 :robot_face:

Avery: Link to staging evidence folder: https://redwood.internal/s3/evidence/soc2/kms-staging — please upload proofs there. @Devon @Priya :thumbsup:

Devon: CR for the keystore schema change is in PR #2423 (https://git.redwood/pr/2423). @Priya can you review by EOD Tue so we can merge before the smoke?

Priya: Will review first thing tomorrow morning. Note: backup HSM path for rollback is set via env `KEYSTORE_BACKUP=/mnt/hsm-backups` — include this in runbook.

Marcus: One dependency to call out: the auditlog ingestion pipeline was dropping some signed events last week. Is that reingested? @Devon

Devon: We merged a collector fix and deployed to staging earlier today. Reingest job is running now; ETA ~2h for completion and verification. I’ll post logs once finished.

Avery: Awesome. Final request for owners: when you update the runbook, add a single-line checklist item under "evidence upload" with the S3 path + ticket ref. I’ll compile and send to the auditors by Apr 5 COB.

Priya: Got it — adding checklist item and runbook snippet now, will ping here when done.

Devon: Once Priya confirms, I’ll cut the patch and schedule the Apr 6 maintenance window with infra calendar.

Avery: Thanks all — if anything slips, escalate to Marcus and add a note in SEC-4821.

Priya: Pinged — runbook updated and checklist item added. SEC-4821 comment posted with links. :ok_hand:
